assay: bulk RNA-seq (paired-end, STAR + featureCounts) of mouse gastrocnemius muscle
design_summary: Male C57BL/6J mice, 4 groups (C chow, CM chow+MICT, H HFD, HM HFD+MICT; n=12/group); HFD weeks 1-21, 8-week moderate-intensity continuous treadmill training weeks 14-21 (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1). RNA-seq n=6/group on C, H and HM only (S2.7.p1, FIG3); CM was not sequenced.
sample_inclusion: 6 per group, C/H/HM; no exclusions stated
primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week MICT on gastrocnemius gene expression in HFD-fed mice (HM vs H); secondary: HFD effect in sedentary mice (H vs C)
planned_contrasts: HM vs H (exercise under HFD; S3.2.p1; paper: 563 DEGs, 213 up / 350 down)
H vs C (diet effect, not exercise; S3.2.p1; paper: 458 DEGs, 295 up / 163 down)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.22.2 on raw counts, BH FDR (S2.7.p1)
paper_results: Table 1 / Table 2 top-50 DEGs; GO (q<0.01) and KEGG (q<0.05) via clusterProfiler
